_doc: European Assault texture table (our own; keys are the disc's 4-char texture SHAPE names, values reference textures of the player's own MOHAA install / the mod's paks). noupscale = textures with lettering or fine print that ESRGAN would garble (DECISIONS 'ESRGAN is for photos and text, not chrome'). Same schema as fl_texmap.json.

5~LX.reason: [look 2026-11-13, user-approved 'Yes upgrade'] spreading bare winter tree card (256 px): Spearhead's bare winter shrub/tree card (HD 1024 px in the mod's foliage pak), cut-out kept, graded on its solid texels

cKVL.reason: [user 2026-11-15 'Online', a barrel-tile set] dark barrel-tile roof (128 px): Poly Haven CC0 clay_roof_tiles (columns of overlapping barrel tiles, as the disc) shipped next to the converter (hd/, CREDITS.txt), baked (flconvert _bake_local): tinted to the disc mean, its stains laid over at half strength (the tile spans ~4.5 disc repeats), tc_scale 0.22 = the disc's ~6 tile columns per repeat (the CC0 tile has 27). Rejected: clay_roof_tiles_03 (flat square tiles, read as a grid in game), ambientCG RoofingTiles008/009 (too regular), ceramic_roof_01 (horizontal courses)
